goal: Працездатний Android MVP Drive2U з повним циклом замовлення, двома ролями та збереженням даних.
scope: локальні product launch config та lockfiles
acceptance_criteria: Пасажир входить, вибирає дві точки на мапі/з переліку Львова, отримує server quote та підтверджує один idempotent ride.
Інший клієнт водія входить, вмикає доступність, приймає Waiting, виконує Accepted → Arrived → InProgress → Completed; історія обох зберігається після перезапуску.
Identity passwords/roles, expiring revocable bearer sessions, SecureStore, owner/role checks; register не призначає Driver.
SQLite EF migrations, idempotent Development seed, transactional concurrency: один accept success та один контрольований409.
FareQuote з server routing, calculator reuse, snapshot тарифу/маршруту/ціни, expiry, чужий quote відхилено.
FR07: passenger cancel Waiting/Accepted; assigned driver cancel Accepted/Arrived з причиною; кінцеві стани незмінні.
SignalR лише учасникам, API refresh на reconnect/foreground та fallback; чужі detail/events недоступні.
Server build/tests/full API smoke, mobile typecheck/Jest/Expo compatibility; Android UI перевірено окремо або чесно позначено недоступним.

decisions.decision: Use Identity UserManager for account/password/role handling plus opaque random256-bit session token; persist only SHA256 token hash, user, expiry and revocation.
decisions.rationale: Binds sessions to Identity identities while allowing immediate logout revocation, bounded expiry and restart persistence without production signing secrets. Built-in protected bearer tickets alone do not automatically revalidate security stamp each request.

decisions.decision: Separate backend server/ ownership from mobile/ ownership; coordinator owns integration/docs/launch configuration.
decisions.rationale: Allows product implementation in parallel without shared-file edits after contract acceptance.

decisions.decision: camelCase JSON, UTC ISO times, enum strings Passenger/Driver and Waiting/Accepted/Arrived/InProgress/Completed/Cancelled.
decisions.rationale: One explicit contract for TypeScript client, API and smoke tests.

decisions.decision: API contract in api_contract object; SignalR is automatic authenticated user scope without client-selected ride groups.
decisions.rationale: Prevents arbitrary foreign ride subscriptions; events cause API refresh and do not expose contacts.

decisions.decision: SQLite immediate write transactions plus unique active-passenger/active-driver indexes and ride version concurrency.
decisions.rationale: Serialize competing mutations before reads and enforce invariants at database boundary; map lock/constraint/concurrency conflicts to409.

decisions.decision: Explicit Demo and Live routing modes; no silent fallback. Persist snapshot geometry, distance, duration, tariff and price in quote and ride.
decisions.rationale: Demo can run without external route provider; live failures remain visible and never become straight-line billed distance.

auth.POST /api/auth/register: {name,email,password} -> Session; only Passenger, reject extra role field
auth.POST /api/auth/logout: bearer current session ->204; revoke persisted session

rides.POST /api/rides: {quoteId:string,idempotencyKey:string} -> Ride; same passenger/key/quote returns original even after quote expiry; same key with other quote409
rides.GET /api/driver/orders: Ride[] with passenger:null and driver:null; no passenger identity before acceptance
rides.POST /api/rides/{id}/cancel: {reason:string} -> Ride; assigned driver reason1..300 characters required

dto.Error: ProblemDetails {status:number,title:string,detail?:string,code?:string}; no raw exception or tokens

realtime.authorization: Authenticated per-user group chosen server-side only. Emit after committed mutation to passenger and assigned driver; no arbitrary join method.
realtime.recovery: Client refetch active/history on event, reconnect and foreground; controlled periodic API refresh while active/offline reconnect. Avoid stale version regression.

api_contract.legacy: Keep /health and /api/fare-estimates for regression compatibility; order flow never trusts distanceKm or amount submitted by client.
